name: Peak-Hold Spectrum Analyser
tags: spectrum, analyser, peak hold, bars, audio, dsp, dark, transform
note: Twenty-six synthesised FFT bands. Bars use fast-attack / slow-release smoothing, peak caps hold then fall under accelerating gravity, and the whole rig boots in on a staggered ramp. Hovering the bars injects a gaussian resonance bump under the pointer; the three buttons tilt the response curve.
html:
SPECTRUM · 26 BAND
60 250 1k 4k 16k

name: Scrolling Waveform Monitor
tags: waveform, scrolling, canvas, ring buffer, transport, meter, audio
note: A ring-buffer waveform that scrolls right to left at 92 px/s on canvas, with a hot write head at the edge and a second inner envelope for transient detail. The transport button morphs its clip-path between pause bars and a play triangle while the scroll speed eases to a stop. Pointer scrub reads back the dB of the column under the cursor.
html: BUS A · 48k -14.0 dB

name: Radial FFT Dial
tags: radial, circular spectrum, svg, rotation, morph, dial, audio
note: Fifty-six SVG rays fanned around a slowly rotating hub, each scaled outward by its band energy through a per-ray transform. Tap the dial to morph the bin mapping between a linear sweep and a mirrored fold, eased over roughly 700 ms; hovering blooms the ray length and spins the hub faster with an eased speed target.
html:
RADIAL FFT LINEAR SWEEP
tap dial to fold

name: Beat-Reactive Particle Field
tags: particles, canvas, physics, beat, shockwave, field, additive
note: Ninety particles drifting through a curl-ish sine field with additive blending and a frame-rate-independent destination-out trail fade. Every kick fires a radial impulse plus an expanding shockwave ring; the pointer becomes a gravity well while it is over the field, and DROP (or a click) throws a double-strength blast.
html: 128 BPM

name: Stereo VU Ballistics
tags: vu meter, needle, ballistics, spring, svg, stereo, analog
note: Two analog VU movements driven by a real second-order system — spring constant 430, damping 27 — integrated at a fixed 4 ms substep so the needles overshoot and settle like a moving coil instead of lerping. The gain slider feeds both channels, clicking a meter punches a decaying transient into it, and the peak LED latches over 0 VU.

name: Phosphor Oscilloscope
tags: oscilloscope, phosphor, canvas, trace, morph, lissajous, crt
note: A CRT trace with genuine phosphor decay: the canvas never clears, it erases a time-scaled slice of its own alpha with destination-out so old sweeps ghost away over the grid beneath. The four buttons cross-fade parametric weights, so SINE to X-Y is a continuous morph of the sampled curve rather than a swap, and a scanline drifts across the glass.
html: 440.0 Hz

name: Album Waveform Ring
tags: album art, ring, svg path, morph, vinyl, player, progress
note: The ring is one SVG path whose d attribute is rebuilt every frame from five summed harmonics plus a beat envelope, so it breathes as a closed waveform instead of tick marks. pathLength is normalised to 100 so the mount stroke-draws in one eased sweep, the sleeve spins on a CSS animation, and pausing eases the ring flat while the progress arc holds its dash offset.
html:
Neon Parallax SUBLIMINAL FM
0:00

name: Mirrored Bars On Water
tags: bars, mirror, reflection, canvas, ripple, sweep, water
note: Thirty-four bars stand on a lit line and their reflection is copied back out of the same canvas in 2px slices, each offset by a travelling sine so the water ripples and the alpha falls off with depth. Moving the pointer across it sweeps a resonant filter through the bands; IMPACT (or a click anywhere) slams every band to full and lets it decay.
html: MIRROR · 34 BAND
